Job Description Software Development: Design, develop, and maintain modern .NET web applications with relational database backends, leveraging Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and robust DBMS principles. review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Job Requirements Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or an equivalent discipline. 3+ years of professional work experience as a .NET Developer , with a heavy emphasis on modern .NET ecosystems. Core Technical Skills Backend & Frameworks: Proficient in C# and modern .NET Core / .NET 6+ (Web API, Minimal APIs). System Deployment : Hands-on experience managing and deploying applications on Windows Server (IIS) and Linux environments. Hands-on experience implementing architectural design patterns, specifically the Repository Pattern and Unit of Work Pattern , with a proven ability to write reusable libraries. Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and TFS. Preferred Qualifications Cloud Ecosystems: Hands-on knowledge of Azure services (e.g., App Services, Azure SQL, Azure OpenAI Service).
